families.title: Student coach reply
families.aim: Generate the live banban coaching reply for learner messages, hints, and summary requests.
families.outcome: Returns a plain-text coaching reply for the learner; the server derives lightweight coaching metadata defaults around that reply.

families.title: Attachment extraction
families.aim: Extract readable homework text and basic metadata from uploaded images or PDFs.
families.outcome: Returns JSON with extractedText, detectedLanguage, confidenceScore, needsManualReview, pageCountEstimate, and sourceSummary.

families.title: Student summary
families.aim: Produce the learner-facing end-of-session summary and next-step recommendation.
families.outcome: Returns JSON with summaryText, weaknessTags, and nextStepRecommendation for the student audience.

families.title: Parent summary
families.aim: Produce the parent-facing oversight summary after session completion.
families.outcome: Returns JSON with summaryText, weaknessTags, and nextStepRecommendation for the parent audience.

families.title: Tutor summary
families.aim: Produce the tutor-facing operational summary after session completion.
families.outcome: Returns JSON with summaryText, weaknessTags, and nextStepRecommendation for the tutor audience.

families.title: Memory refresh
families.aim: Refresh durable pedagogical memory after a completed session.
families.outcome: Returns JSON with 0 to 6 educational memory items, each with category, title, detail, and confidence.

families.title: Summary translation
families.aim: Translate generated summary text for additional oversight languages without changing meaning.
